metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py) and the executable [iges](/workspace/output/iges), using only Python’s standard library.

All five commands and 87 entity schemas are supported. Compilation and 30 tests pass, including 113 type/form fixtures and deterministic round-trips.

Usage and preservation details are in [README.md](/workspace/output/README.md). External vendor CAD files were unavailable for verification.

editorial.last_message: Claims all five commands and 87 entity schemas implemented with the standard library; 30 self-tests across 113 type/form fixtures are corroborated. Current corrected grading passes 249/249. External vendor CAD validation remains unverified.
editorial.notes:
Retained review covers the complete canonical action sequence, preserved sessions, general implementation and authored self-tests. The unchanged source passes all 249 cases under committed IGES 1.0.19. All 246 unchanged outcomes match the prior 261/261 publication and the three consolidated appendix integrations pass. The independently reviewed Status/Structure normalization removes invalid or conflicted prerequisites; combining fifteen cases into three explicitly changes weighting while retaining every observation. This is a rubric correction, not source improvement. Earlier corrections of illegal shared 0H data and invalid typed graphs changed original 170/260 to 261/261 under 1.0.17; the complete publication and audit history remains preserved. Root verified source and original-result hashes, unchanged model inputs, pinned grader, unique cases, complete session accounting and unchanged generation cost. Original apps-available-unused cohort is retained. No model calls were made for regrading. Perfect covered-test performance does not establish full IGES conformance or vendor CAD interoperability.

Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

IGES 1.0.20 retained-source regrade: all 249 case IDs and245 untouched outcomes preserved; four supporting View fixtures corrected to the complete defaulted canonical shape. Score unchanged. All original generation/source/session/accounting artifacts and complete previous publication remain preserved. No additional model calls or cost.
